DeviceAuthorizationRequest.description: Request body for initiating a device authorization flow. The client sends its `client_id` and an optional `scope`. The API server proxies the device authorization request to the upstream provider and tracks it as a login attempt.

DeviceTokenExchangeRequest.description: Request body for the device token exchange. The client polls this endpoint with the device_code received from the authorization step.

code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier (RFC 7636). Required for all authorization code exchanges.

idp_refresh_token.description: Refresh token issued by the upstream identity provider. Returned under the same conditions as `idp_token`, and only when the provider issued one.

idp_token.description: Access token issued by the upstream identity provider. Only returned when the caller requested it and holds the `RetrieveRemoteAccessToken` permission.

scope.description: The scope granted to the access token per RFC 6749 §5.1. An empty string indicates no permissions. Use "full" for all permissions.
